 Federal High Court Announces Christmas Vacation, Resumption Date | Real Broadcasting Network Federal High Court Announces Christmas Vacation, Resumption Date
 By Damilola Olufemi 1 min read RELATED Court Upholds Wali’s Yobe APC Governorship Candidacy, Dismisses Maihaja’s Suit APC Tells Atiku, ADC to Resolve Internal Crisis After Court Judgment Court Grants Doris Ogala N30m Bail in Cyberstalking Case INEC Yet to Receive Court Judgment on ADC Leadership Dispute I’m Not Going Anywhere, We’ll Be on 2027 Ballot — Atiku Federal High Court Abuja. 
 The Federal High Court of Nigeria will begin its 2026 Christmas vacation on December 21, with regular court proceedings scheduled to resume on January 6, 2027.
 The Chief Judge of the court, Justice John Tsoho, approved the vacation in line with Order 46, Rule 4(c) of the Federal High Court (Civil) Procedure Rules, 2019.
 According to a statement issued on Monday by the court’s Director of Information, Dr Catherine Christopher, the vacation will end on January 5, 2027.
 Only designated judicial divisions will operate during the break, handling urgent matters requiring judicial attention.
 “It is important to note that, during the vacation period, the Vacation Judges shall entertain only matters relating to the enforcement of fundamental rights, the arrest or release of vessels, and other matters of urgent national importance such as trial of pre- election cases,” Christopher said.
 The designated vacation judges are:
 Abuja Judicial Division – Justice I. E. Ekwo, Justice O. A. Egwuatu
 Lagos Judicial Division – Justice Akintayo Aluko, Justice Ogazi F. Nkemakonam
 Port Harcourt Judicial Division – Justice P. M. Ayua, Justice A. T. Mohammed
 Enugu Judicial Division – Justice F. O. G. Ogunbanjo, Justice M. T. Segun-Bello
 The Chief Judge extended Christmas and New Year greetings to judges and members of the court.
